name: apple-mail-local
description: Read Apple Mail accounts and messages through local macOS automation.

interface.shortDescription: Safely inspect Mail.app without storing credentials.
interface.longDescription: Lists accounts and mailboxes, searches recent messages, and reads message content through Apple Mail's supported automation interface. Read-only tools are enabled by default; reply drafts require an explicit local opt-in and confirmation.
defaultPrompt: List the accounts configured in Apple Mail.
Find recent unread messages in Apple Mail.
Summarize an Apple Mail message without taking action.
